rollback_evidence: 1.0.12 G137 (J08, J20), measured on vJunos-switch 26.2R1.7 (ELS, model ex9214; GNS3 lab, task-evidence/g137) with the safeguard of the Junos interface profile: an empty 'commit confirmed 10 comment "netops-<id>"' first, the change committed with 'commit confirmed 10 comment "netops-change"', the confirmation 'commit comment "netops-<id>-ok"'; an expiry returns the configuration before the change, VLANs included. The key is the VLAN ID (1 is the implicit VLAN default and protected); the name is an attribute. Lines: 'set vlans <name> vlan-id <id>', 'set vlans <name> description "TEXT"' (UTF-8 text as for the interface description), 'delete vlans <name>' and 'rename vlans <old> to <new>'.
